literal.prompt: Кого Земский собор избрал царём в 1613 году?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Presidential Library article says the Time of Troubles ended with Mikhail Romanov being elected in 1613 (L49); its retained Romanov collection states specifically that the Zemsky Sobor elected Mikhail Fedorovich Romanov (L343). Together these establish the prompt, the four distinct ruler/claimant options, and the unique key at index 2.
literalGroups.locator: PRlib article L49; retained PRlib Romanov collection L343.

literalGroups.literal: В 1613 году Земский собор избрал царём Михаила Фёдоровича Романова. Это событие положило начало династии Романовых и стало важным рубежом окончания Смуты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained collection directly names the Zemsky Sobor election of Mikhail Fedorovich Romanov (L343). The official library article says popular election of Mikhail in 1613 ended the Time of Troubles (L49), grounding both sentences.
literalGroups.locator: Retained PRlib Romanov collection L343; PRlib article L49.

literalGroups.literal: После свержения Лжедмитрия I боярство выдвинуло Василия Шуйского на престол; в 1610 году его свергли.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The official library article says Vasily Shuisky and associates conspired against the recognized False Dmitry I, then the boyars put Shuisky on the throne (L53-L54); it explicitly says Shuisky was deposed in 1610 (L56). The revision states only those supported facts.

literalGroups.literal: В июне 1605 года Лжедмитрия I признали царём в Москве; позднее его свергли и убили.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The article states that in June 1605 False Dmitry I entered Moscow and was recognized as tsar by the people and part of the nobility; it then says he was deposed and killed (L53). The note avoids assigning an unsupported end year.

The retained Romanov collection identifies Mikhail Fedorovich as tsar and gives his life dates as 1596–1645 (L346). The note adds this concrete biographical fact about the correct option beyond the prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: Сын Михаила Фёдоровича, царь Алексей Михайлович жил в 1629–1676 годах.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The retained Romanov collection calls Alexei Mikhailovich the son of Mikhail Fedorovich and a tsar, and gives his life dates as 1629–1676 (L346).
